name: the parent marker is matched inline, so prose mentioning it becomes a declaration
expect: prose mentioning a parent is NOT a declaration

name: a step-less plan counts as DONE, which is true of arithmetic and false of work
edits: "done": x + o > 0 and o == 0, "empty": x + o == 0}
expect: ⛔ a plan with NO steps is neither done nor open

name: a dangling parent is dropped, so the middle of an old line becomes a new one
expect: ⛔ a parent that does not exist is REPORTED, and the child still renders

name: a line is judged by its TIP alone, so an unfinished parent under a finished tip hides
expect: ⭐ a line is OPEN when any node in it is open, even under a finished tip

name: completed lines sort first again, burying everything that still owes something
edits: for r in sorted(_by_date, key=lambda n: 0 if line_state(n) == "open" else 1):
for r in sorted(_by_date, key=lambda n: 1 if line_state(n) == "open" else 0):
expect: ⭐ an OPEN line sorts above a COMPLETED one, even when the completed one is newer

name: the badge asserts abandonment from an unticked box
edits: badge, cls = f'{n["ticked"]}/{n["total"]} not ticked closed', "st-open"
expect: ⛔ the BADGE says 'not ticked closed' and never 'abandoned'

name: a missing plan directory renders an empty page instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: raise ValueError(f"{d} is not a directory, so there are no work lines to read")
expect: a MISSING plan directory is CANNOT RUN (2) and the message NAMES it

name: the slug is not escaped, so a plan name can inject markup
expect: a slug is HTML-escaped, so a plan name cannot inject markup

name: a cycle's edge is never cut, so its members keep their circular children and the page hangs
edits: par["children"] = [c for c in par["children"] if c["slug"] != cut]
expect: ⛔ a two-node cycle becomes a tree: each plan appears EXACTLY once

name: `parent: -` collapses into 'nothing recorded', so a line started today reads like one never recorded
expect: ⭐ `parent: -` is a STARTED line — no parent, and distinguishable from nothing recorded

name: the serving line is not escaped, so a stated objective can inject markup
expect: the serving line and an orphan's name are escaped too

name: the open-line count states ALL lines, so a page of finished work still says it owes something
expect: the count of lines that still owe something is the REAL count

name: the cycle cut takes the first unplaced node OVERALL, so a tail below a cycle is cut and one line becomes three
expect: ⛔ a cycle is cut ON the cycle: tails sorting before it stay attached, ONE line results

name: the cycle is cut where the walk MET it, not at its first member, so the cut moves with the walk's start
expect: ⛔ the cut is at the ALPHABETICALLY FIRST cycle member, not where the walk met it

name: a directory named *.md is read as a plan, so one stray name stops the whole page
expect: a DIRECTORY named *.md is not a plan, and does not stop the page

name: the page renders no Refresh button, so a hand-edited plan cannot be rebuilt from the page
expect: ⭐ the page carries a Refresh button for the `work-lines` key, wired by the shared chrome

name: plan_dirs no longer skips a MISSING checkout with a note
expect: WT5 a checkout whose directory is MISSING is skipped and NAMED, never fatal

name: plan_dirs falls back to this checkout SILENTLY when git cannot answer
edits:
return [own], [f"git could not list the worktrees ({why}), so only this checkout's plans "
                       f"were read"]
expect: WT7 when git cannot answer, the result is THIS checkout only — and a note SAYS so

edits:
for t in trees:
    for t in reversed(trees):
expect: WT1 plan_dirs lists EVERY checkout from a real `git worktree add`, main first

expect: WT2 the page reads a plan that exists ONLY in another worktree — the chrome-bar-fold case — and labels BOTH copies of a slug held twice, never merging them
